23	## 2. Story Arc
24	
25	Multi-turn dialogue performance in LLMs degrades as conversations grow longer. Dongre et al. (2026) quantified this through the Goal Attention Ratio (GAR), showing 27-48% drops over 50 turns, while their residual stream probes reveal that goal information persists (AUC up to 0.98) even as the attention channel closes. This creates a natural hypothesis: if the information is in the residual stream but attention fails to access it, a learnable gate on the residual connection should recover it. We implement this hypothesis as ThreadGate, a per-layer gating module trained with joint NTP and GAR objectives. ThreadGate successfully optimizes GAR during training (0.02 to 0.48), and this improvement transfers perfectly when evaluated on same-distribution text at inference (GAR-ours = 0.49). However, on model-generated text, GAR-ours collapses to 0.016—a 30× gap driven by text distribution shift. Our central finding is that attention patterns learned under teacher-forced contexts (gold text) do not generalize to autoregressive generation contexts (model-generated text), the classic exposure bias phenomenon. This distribution shift is structural, independent of loss design or gating architecture. We further identify two coupled mechanisms that amplify the shift: (1) NTP loss dominates gate gradients, causing gates to learn reverse turn conditioning (suppressing at early turns where GAR is high, becoming passive at late turns where intervention is needed); (2) at inference time, gates attenuate residual updates by only 2-7%, far too weak to shift attention patterns. Four-way ablation (ThreadGate vs. Uniform Gate vs. LoRA-only vs. Base) confirms gating provides zero incremental contribution. Notably, this 30× gap is specific to GAR-ours (last-token attention to goals); GAR-Dongre (all-token attention) shows uniformly low values regardless of text distribution, revealing that exposure bias selectively disrupts summary-position attention patterns. Combined with Dongre et al.'s independent failure of goal re-injection, our results provide the first empirical characterization of how text distribution shift (exposure bias) selectively destroys attention patterns learned through auxiliary losses, and identify the specific mechanisms through which this vulnerability manifests.

52	## 5. Key Selling Points
53	
54	**SP1 (核心卖点): Exposure bias 对 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的首个实证刻画。** 30x training-inference GAR-ours gap 提供了 teacher-forcing distribution shift 如何摧毁 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的实证证据。训练时模型在 gold context 上优化 attention pattern，推理时在自身生成的 context 上条件化——两者分布不同导致 attention pattern 不迁移。虽然 exposure bias 概念本身已知 (Bengio et al. 2015)，且 sequence generation 中有量化先例 (Ranzato et al. 2016, Wiseman & Rush 2016)，但此前无人刻画其对 auxiliary attention loss 的具体影响。我们的 30x gap 测量展示了这种脆弱性在 attention steering 场景下的严重程度。**注意：(1) claim scope 严格限于 lightweight residual gating + GAR auxiliary loss 的实测范围，不泛化到所有 attention steering 方法。(2) 30x gap 在 GAR-ours（last token only, summary-position attention）上测得（IID 0.50 vs model-gen 0.016）；GAR-Dongre（all response tokens）在两种分布上均低（~0.01-0.019），无 gap——表明 exposure bias 选择性影响 summary-position attention pattern，这一差异本身有分析价值。**
55	
56	**SP2: NTP-GAR 梯度动力学 + PCGrad 因果排除（gradient conflict is inconsequential）。** 观察到 67-79% 的层 NTP-GAR 梯度方向冲突（cos_sim<0）+ NTP 幅度 3-15x 压制 GAR（mag_ratio 7.5→14.7x）。**PCGrad 消融（D028）因果排除方向冲突**：投影后 cos_sim 围绕 0 震荡（range -0.151 to +0.091），L_GAR 坍塌轨迹不变。**推理端确认（IID same-protocol）**: v9 IID PPL = 2.780 vs v7 = 2.784（差 0.004，无改善）; v9 GAR-ours = 0.0151 vs v7 = 0.0157（差 <0.1pp）——**PCGrad 消除方向冲突后所有可观测指标均无变化**（GAR、PPL、NTP 均 ≈ v7）。方向冲突虽然可测量存在于 v7 中，但对训练和推理结果无任何因果影响——10-40× NTP 幅度主导使方向冲突完全无关紧要（inconsequential）。**⚠️ M017: 此前 "PPL -46%" 和 "selective dissociation" 论述为跨协议对比伪影（model-gen PPL 1.50 vs IID PPL 2.78），已撤回。** **精确 claim scope**: gradient direction conflict is **neither necessary nor sufficient** for the 30x GAR gap; exposure bias alone is sufficient。NOT necessary: 移除冲突→gap仍在; NOT sufficient: v7有冲突但L_GAR训练时收敛; Exposure bias is sufficient: 训练≠推理分布→GAR泛化失败。**Gate 行为额外 insight**: v9 gate dynamic range 比 v7 更宽 (L15 range 0.33 vs v7 0.21)——PCGrad 给 gate 更大自由度，但 gate 用该自由度更激进地优化 NTP 而非 GAR，说明优化景观固有偏好语言建模目标。
57	
58	**SP3: Principled 设计动机 + 系统性探索。** Dongre 发现 goal info 在 residual stream 持续存在 (probe AUC=0.98)，residual gating 是最直接的架构响应。v1-v7 覆盖 4 种核心 loss 设计 across 7 training configurations，MSE+gate_div 是唯一训练收敛方案。四路消融严格隔离贡献: TG (learned gate + GAR loss) / UG (uniform gate + GAR loss) / LoRA-only (gate=1.0 fixed + GAR loss, 无 gating 机制) / Base。注意：三个 fine-tuned 变体均使用 GAR loss，消融测试的是 gating 机制的增量贡献，而非 GAR loss 本身的效果。
59	
60	**SP4: Convergent evidence with Dongre。** Dongre diagnosed the problem; we attempted the first systematic cure and uncovered fundamental limitations。两种独立干预路线（goal re-injection + residual gating）均失败，共同指向 NTP 优化压力下 attention steering 的根本困难。
61	
62	**SP5: 三阶段训练动力学。** v7 展现 plateau → phase transition → convergence 的清晰训练动力学，证明 MSE 双向 loss 设计本身是 sound 的，问题在泛化而非训练。

# Paper Framing: Mechanistic Analysis of Training-Inference Distribution Shift in Attention Steering

> 定位: **Mechanistic insight paper**（不是简单 negative result）。核心卖点是 teacher-forcing→generation 分布偏移如何摧毁 lightweight residual gating 的 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性（30x 断层的定量证据）。这个 insight 为 auxiliary attention loss 在 teacher-forcing 下的 exposure bias 脆弱性提供首个实证刻画。
> Novelty 排序: (1) exposure bias 对 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的首个实证刻画 (30x gap) > (2) PCGrad 因果排除梯度方向冲突 + "观察→假设→排除→指向真因" 完整因果链 (D028) > (3) principled intervention + systematic ablation 的 negative result
> **⚠️ Dream review D024: "Cannot" overclaims, novelty "first measurement" 过高, 缺 gradient surgery baseline (PCGrad). 标题改 "Fails to", novelty 降级 "first empirical characterization"**
> 目标会议: EMNLP 2026, ARR August cycle, deadline 2026-08-03 (~10.5 weeks)
> 最后更新: 2026-05-20 (M017 修正: PPL -46% 为跨协议伪影, IID PPL 无差异; selective dissociation 撤回; D033 跨变体确认)
> **⚠️ Llama-3 跨模型验证 = MUST-HAVE**（不含 → Findings 3.0 紧绷；含 → 3.0-3.5）

---

## 1. Title Candidates

- **T1 (推荐)**: Why Lightweight Gating Fails to Fix Multi-Turn Attention Degradation: A Mechanistic Analysis
- **T2**: The Distribution Shift Trap: Why Training-Time Attention Steering Fails at Inference
- **T3**: Residual Gating Fails to Recover Goal Attention in Multi-Turn Dialogue
- **T4**: Lightweight Gating Struggles with Multi-Turn Attention Degradation: Evidence from Exposure Bias

推荐 T1: "Fails to Fix" 替代 "Cannot Fix"（审稿共识：证据仅支持 tested conditions 下的失败，非绝对否定）。"Lightweight Gating" 覆盖标量+uniform gate。

---

## 2. Story Arc

Multi-turn dialogue performance in LLMs degrades as conversations grow longer. Dongre et al. (2026) quantified this through the Goal Attention Ratio (GAR), showing 27-48% drops over 50 turns, while their residual stream probes reveal that goal information persists (AUC up to 0.98) even as the attention channel closes. This creates a natural hypothesis: if the information is in the residual stream but attention fails to access it, a learnable gate on the residual connection should recover it. We implement this hypothesis as ThreadGate, a per-layer gating module trained with joint NTP and GAR objectives. ThreadGate successfully optimizes GAR during training (0.02 to 0.48), and this improvement transfers perfectly when evaluated on same-distribution text at inference (GAR-ours = 0.49). However, on model-generated text, GAR-ours collapses to 0.016—a 30× gap driven by text distribution shift. Our central finding is that attention patterns learned under teacher-forced contexts (gold text) do not generalize to autoregressive generation contexts (model-generated text), the classic exposure bias phenomenon. This distribution shift is structural, independent of loss design or gating architecture. We further identify two coupled mechanisms that amplify the shift: (1) NTP loss dominates gate gradients, causing gates to learn reverse turn conditioning (suppressing at early turns where GAR is high, becoming passive at late turns where intervention is needed); (2) at inference time, gates attenuate residual updates by only 2-7%, far too weak to shift attention patterns. Four-way ablation (ThreadGate vs. Uniform Gate vs. LoRA-only vs. Base) confirms gating provides zero incremental contribution. Notably, this 30× gap is specific to GAR-ours (last-token attention to goals); GAR-Dongre (all-token attention) shows uniformly low values regardless of text distribution, revealing that exposure bias selectively disrupts summary-position attention patterns. Combined with Dongre et al.'s independent failure of goal re-injection, our results provide the first empirical characterization of how text distribution shift (exposure bias) selectively destroys attention patterns learned through auxiliary losses, and identify the specific mechanisms through which this vulnerability manifests.

---

## 3. Core Claims

| # | Claim | 支撑 | 状态 |
|---|-------|------|------|
| C1 | GAR 衰减是真实且严重的结构性现象: Qwen-2.5-7B raw GAR 下降 70.8%, normalized GAR 下降 ~21% | Phase 1 GAR 诊断 | ✅ 已验证 |
| C2 | Residual gating 训练时在 same-distribution text 上有效优化 GAR-ours (0.48→0.49 泛化成功)，但在 model-generated text 上完全失败 (GAR-ours=0.016, 30x text distribution shift gap)。GAR-Dongre 在两种分布上均低（~0.01-0.016），无 gap——说明分布偏移选择性影响 summary-position attention pattern。 | v7 训练曲线 + 4-way eval + v7 直接 eval + Reviewer 独立验证 (D024) | ✅ 已验证（precision upgrade） |
| C3 | 失败机制的因果分析: (1) Distribution shift 是主因（D028 PCGrad 因果排除梯度方向冲突）; (2) NTP 幅度主导 gate 学习 → NF1 反向 turn conditioning; (3) NF3 gate 干预强度不足 2-7%。PCGrad ablation: 消除方向冲突后 cos_sim 围绕 0 震荡(range -0.151 to +0.091)，但 L_GAR 坍塌轨迹不变且无延迟 → 方向冲突非因果因素。**推理端确认（IID same-protocol）**: v9 GAR-ours=0.0151 vs v7=0.0157 (差<0.1pp), **v9 IID PPL=2.780 vs v7=2.784 (差0.004，无改善)**——PCGrad 消除方向冲突后所有可观测指标均 ≈ v7，方向冲突因 NTP 幅度主导而完全 inconsequential | D014 gate-profile + 梯度冲突量化 + **D028 PCGrad 因果排除** + v9 推理 eval + **M017 PPL 修正** | ✅ **End-to-end 完成**: 训练端 + 推理端均确认梯度方向冲突对 GAR 和 PPL 均无因果影响 |
| C4 | Gating 无增量贡献: 四路消融 LoRA-only ≈ TG ≈ UG（GAR + PPL 双指标）。IID: GAR 差异<0.6pp, PPL 均 ~2.78。**Model-gen (D033): v9 PCGrad=0.0151, UG=0.0149, LoRA-only=0.0245 均接近 baseline 0.0122——30x gap 在所有训练变体上普遍存在，排除 gating mechanism / turn-conditioning / gradient conflict 作为因果因素** | D021 四路 eval + D033 model-gen eval | ✅ **双重验证**: IID (D021) + model-gen (D033)。model-gen regime 进一步确认 gating 零增量且 GAR collapse 是训练-推理分布偏移的普遍现象 |
| C5 | 跨模型验证: Llama-3.1-8B 上复现同样的失败模式 | Phase 1 ✅ (GAR decay 90.1%, D042), Phase 2 训练中 | ⏳ Phase 1 done, Phase 2 running |

---

## 4. Negative Findings (NF)

| # | Finding | 证据 | 叙事角色 |
|---|---------|------|----------|
| NF1 | Gate turn conditioning 方向反转: 27/28 层 gate diff (turn1-turn21) < 0，早期 turn 强抑制，晚期 turn passive | D014 eval gate-profile | 解释 why gating fails: NTP 梯度推 gate→1.0，晚期 turn 推力最强 |
| NF2 | 30x text distribution shift gap (GAR-ours): ultrachat 文本 0.49 vs 模型生成文本 0.016。Same-distribution 泛化成功（训练 0.48 → ultrachat eval 0.49），cross-distribution 泛化失败。**D033 跨变体确认**: v9 PCGrad (0.0151), UG (0.0149), LoRA-only (0.0245) model-gen GAR 均接近 baseline (0.0122)——gap 独立于训练策略，是 exposure bias 的普遍表现。GAR-Dongre 在两种分布上均低（~0.01-0.019），无 gap——分布偏移选择性影响 summary-position (last token) attention pattern | D015 + 4-way eval + v7 direct eval + D024 + **D033 cross-variant model-gen** | 核心 negative finding。精确定位为 TEXT DISTRIBUTION SHIFT（exposure bias）。D033 确认跨所有训练变体的普遍性。 |
| NF3 | 推理时 gate attenuation 仅 2-7% (gate_mean=0.93-0.98)，近乎 identity | D014 gate dynamic range 数据 | 解释 why 推理时 GAR 不改善: 干预强度不足 |
| NF4 | Eval baseline confound (Phase1 base vs Phase2 LoRA 文本不同) | P0 代码分析 | 已修正 → standard_conversations.json 统一 eval |

---

## 5. Key Selling Points

**SP1 (核心卖点): Exposure bias 对 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的首个实证刻画。** 30x training-inference GAR-ours gap 提供了 teacher-forcing distribution shift 如何摧毁 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的实证证据。训练时模型在 gold context 上优化 attention pattern，推理时在自身生成的 context 上条件化——两者分布不同导致 attention pattern 不迁移。虽然 exposure bias 概念本身已知 (Bengio et al. 2015)，且 sequence generation 中有量化先例 (Ranzato et al. 2016, Wiseman & Rush 2016)，但此前无人刻画其对 auxiliary attention loss 的具体影响。我们的 30x gap 测量展示了这种脆弱性在 attention steering 场景下的严重程度。**注意：(1) claim scope 严格限于 lightweight residual gating + GAR auxiliary loss 的实测范围，不泛化到所有 attention steering 方法。(2) 30x gap 在 GAR-ours（last token only, summary-position attention）上测得（IID 0.50 vs model-gen 0.016）；GAR-Dongre（all response tokens）在两种分布上均低（~0.01-0.019），无 gap——表明 exposure bias 选择性影响 summary-position attention pattern，这一差异本身有分析价值。**

**SP2: NTP-GAR 梯度动力学 + PCGrad 因果排除（gradient conflict is inconsequential）。** 观察到 67-79% 的层 NTP-GAR 梯度方向冲突（cos_sim<0）+ NTP 幅度 3-15x 压制 GAR（mag_ratio 7.5→14.7x）。**PCGrad 消融（D028）因果排除方向冲突**：投影后 cos_sim 围绕 0 震荡（range -0.151 to +0.091），L_GAR 坍塌轨迹不变。**推理端确认（IID same-protocol）**: v9 IID PPL = 2.780 vs v7 = 2.784（差 0.004，无改善）; v9 GAR-ours = 0.0151 vs v7 = 0.0157（差 <0.1pp）——**PCGrad 消除方向冲突后所有可观测指标均无变化**（GAR、PPL、NTP 均 ≈ v7）。方向冲突虽然可测量存在于 v7 中，但对训练和推理结果无任何因果影响——10-40× NTP 幅度主导使方向冲突完全无关紧要（inconsequential）。**⚠️ M017: 此前 "PPL -46%" 和 "selective dissociation" 论述为跨协议对比伪影（model-gen PPL 1.50 vs IID PPL 2.78），已撤回。** **精确 claim scope**: gradient direction conflict is **neither necessary nor sufficient** for the 30x GAR gap; exposure bias alone is sufficient。NOT necessary: 移除冲突→gap仍在; NOT sufficient: v7有冲突但L_GAR训练时收敛; Exposure bias is sufficient: 训练≠推理分布→GAR泛化失败。**Gate 行为额外 insight**: v9 gate dynamic range 比 v7 更宽 (L15 range 0.33 vs v7 0.21)——PCGrad 给 gate 更大自由度，但 gate 用该自由度更激进地优化 NTP 而非 GAR，说明优化景观固有偏好语言建模目标。

**SP3: Principled 设计动机 + 系统性探索。** Dongre 发现 goal info 在 residual stream 持续存在 (probe AUC=0.98)，residual gating 是最直接的架构响应。v1-v7 覆盖 4 种核心 loss 设计 across 7 training configurations，MSE+gate_div 是唯一训练收敛方案。四路消融严格隔离贡献: TG (learned gate + GAR loss) / UG (uniform gate + GAR loss) / LoRA-only (gate=1.0 fixed + GAR loss, 无 gating 机制) / Base。注意：三个 fine-tuned 变体均使用 GAR loss，消融测试的是 gating 机制的增量贡献，而非 GAR loss 本身的效果。

**SP4: Convergent evidence with Dongre。** Dongre diagnosed the problem; we attempted the first systematic cure and uncovered fundamental limitations。两种独立干预路线（goal re-injection + residual gating）均失败，共同指向 NTP 优化压力下 attention steering 的根本困难。

**SP5: 三阶段训练动力学。** v7 展现 plateau → phase transition → convergence 的清晰训练动力学，证明 MSE 双向 loss 设计本身是 sound 的，问题在泛化而非训练。

6. **Experiments**: 四路消融 (TG/UG/LoRA-only/Base) with GAR + PPL dual metrics + 跨模型验证 (Llama-3.1-8B)
7. **Analysis**: §6.1 NTP-GAR 梯度冲突观察 → §6.2 Gate turn conditioning (Wilcoxon) → §6.3 **PCGrad 因果排除方向冲突** → §6.4 Distribution shift (exposure bias) 作为主因 → §6.5 attention 可视化 + 训练动力学
8. **Discussion**: 为什么 lightweight residual gating 不够 → exposure bias 对 auxiliary attention loss 的具体影响机制 → 潜在解决方向 (inference-time intervention / exposure bias mitigation for auxiliary losses / decoupled pathway / GAR-aware decoding) → **scope 声明: claim 限于 lightweight gating，不泛化到所有 attention steering**
9. **Conclusion**: negative result 总结 + 对社区的 actionable 建议

### 贡献列表（按 novelty 排序）

1. **Exposure bias 对 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性的首个实证刻画**: 实证展示 teacher-forcing distribution shift 如何摧毁 lightweight residual gating 的 auxiliary attention loss 泛化性（30x training-inference GAR-ours gap），为 teacher-forcing 下的 attention steering 方法提供具体风险标杆
2. **NTP-GAR 梯度竞争的逐层量化**: NTP loss 在 gate 参数上的梯度与 GAR loss 冲突，导致 gates 学到反向 turn conditioning（27/28 层 gate 在晚期 turn 趋向 identity）
3. **首个 principled residual gating 干预 + 系统性消融**: 基于 Dongre 的 residual stream persistence 证据设计 ThreadGate，v1-v7 覆盖 4 种核心 loss (cumulative v1-v2, maximize v3-v5, smooth_saturation v6, mse_target v7) + 四路消融隔离贡献，为后续研究提供 negative baseline

- **Best case**: 3.0 (Weak Reject / Findings-level)。主要扣分: claim 过度泛化 (W1), 引用不足 (W6), 单 seed (W7)。
- **Median case**: 3.0 (Weak Reject)。同上 + distribution shift insight incremental (W5)。
- **Worst case**: 未完成 review（crash），但 imagined experiments 显示最坏情况下 Llama-3 不复现 dramatic pattern。

### 修正后预期
- **收窄 claim + 扩充引用 + code 验证后**: best 预期 3.5 (Weak Accept / Borderline Conference)。移除两个 Major weakness (W1 overclaim + W6 thin refs)。
- **加 bootstrap CI + Llama-3 数据后**: median 预期 3.0-3.5。
- **冲 Main 条件**: 上述修正 + exposure-bias mitigation 实验 (W8) + 25-30 references。
- **核心差异化**: 不是 "gating 失败了"（弱），而是 "exposure bias 在 auxiliary attention loss 上的首个定量测量 + 失败机制 taxonomy"。
- **关键风险**: W5（exposure bias 已知）需要精确定位增量；W7（单 seed）需 bootstrap CI 或追加 seed。

file.content:
categories:
  layer_importance:
    description: Layer-wise importance analysis, redundancy, and pruning in transformers
    papers:
    - title: The Unreasonable Ineffectiveness of the Deeper Layers
      authors: Gromov et al.
      venue: ICLR 2025
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.17887
      role: foundation
      relevance: 发现 LLM 深层高度冗余，可删除近半层而性能不降；浅层对知识存储至关重要
      abstract: Studies knowledge storage via layer pruning. Finds minimal performance degradation until up to half of layers
        are removed.
    - title: 'ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect'
      authors: Men et al.
      venue: arXiv 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.03853
      role: foundation
      relevance: 提出 Block Influence (BI) 度量各层重要性，发现许多层高度相似且功能冗余
      abstract: Defines Block Influence (BI) metric to gauge layer significance. Discovers many LLM layers exhibit high similarity.
    - title: The Curse of Depth in Large Language Models
      authors: Sun et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05795
      role: foundation
      relevance: Pre-LN 导致深层梯度趋近恒等映射。解释 ThreadGate 中 late layers gate 接近 1.0
      abstract: Pre-Layer Normalization causes output variance to grow exponentially with depth.
    - title: 'Reassessing Layer Pruning in LLMs: New Insights and Methods'
      authors: Anonymous
      venue: arXiv 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15558
      role: context
      relevance: 删除最后 25% 层 + 微调即可获得强性能，证实深层冗余
      abstract: Simply pruning the final 25% of layers followed by fine-tuning yields strong performance.
    - title: Reducing Transformer Depth on Demand with Structured Dropout (LayerDrop)
      authors: Fan et al.
      venue: ICLR 2020
      year: 2020
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.11556
      role: method-component
      relevance: ThreadGate 的 gating 可视为 LayerDrop 的 soft 版本
      abstract: Structured dropout on entire transformer layers during training.
  multi_turn_attention:
    description: Attention degradation and instruction following failure in multi-turn or long-context scenarios
    papers:
    - title: 'When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction'
      authors: Dongre, Hsieh, Lai, Yoon, Bui, Hakkani-Tur
      venue: arXiv 2026
      year: 2026
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12922
      role: foundation
      relevance: 定义 GAR，诊断多轮 attention 通道关闭。纯诊断论文，未提出干预方案。ThreadGate 是首个基于其诊断的干预方法
      abstract: 'Channel-transition account: goal tokens become less accessible through attention while goal info persists
        in residual representations. Introduces GAR metric.'
      notes:
        gar_definition: GAR(τ) = (1/L·H·|ℛτ|) Σℓ Σh Σi∈ℛτ Σj∈𝒢 A_{i,j}. ALL layers, ALL heads averaged. Goal tokens = system
          prompt task-specifying tokens only
        models_tested: Mistral-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5 (3B/7B/14B/32B), Mixtral-8x7B + 6 additional
        gar_decline: 27-48% over 50 turns, monotonic (Mann-Kendall p<1e-7)
        residual_probes: 'LDA on PCA-reduced residuals (50 PCs). Peak AUC: LLaMA L2=0.99, Qwen L11=0.98, Mixtral L21=0.99,
          Mistral L27=0.87'
        qwen_layer_profile: Goal encoding rises steeply from L5. Our v3b L4 outlier may be the layer just before goal encoding
          begins
        intervention_tested: Periodic goal re-injection FAILED (Appendix H)
        no_solution: true
        sliding_window: Attention mask W=4096, Qwen crossover at turn 20. Linear W-vs-crossover (R2~1)
        framing_impact: GAR not our original metric. No intervention proposed -> ThreadGate is first solution. Residual persistence
          directly supports our theory
    - title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation
      authors: Levy et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06120
      role: foundation
      relevance: 量化多轮对话性能衰减：平均下降 39%，不可靠性增加 112%
      abstract: All top LLMs exhibit significantly lower performance in multi-turn vs single-turn, averaging 39% drop.
    - title: Intent Mismatch Causes LLMs to Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation
      authors: Liu et al.
      venue: arXiv 2026
      year: 2026
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07338
      role: context
      relevance: 多轮失败根因是 intent alignment gap，scaling 无法解决。支撑 ThreadGate 架构级方案动机
      abstract: Lost in Conversation stems from intent alignment gap, not capability deficits. Scaling cannot resolve.
    - title: 'Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts'
      authors: Liu et al.
      venue: TACL 2024
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172
      role: foundation
      relevance: U 型 attention 分布（首尾强、中间弱）。多轮场景是此现象在 turn boundary 上的扩展
      abstract: Performance highest at beginning/end of context, degrading for middle positions.
    - title: 'Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models'
      authors: Anonymous
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23578
      role: context
      relevance: 多轮对话中 style instruction 遵循衰减，system message 比 user message 更严重
      abstract: Style instruction in system messages degrades more than in user messages across turns.
  residual_gating:
    description: Gating mechanisms for transformer residual connections and adaptive depth
    papers:
    - title: 'Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models'
      authors: Raposo et al.
      venue: arXiv 2024 (Google DeepMind)
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02258
      role: method-component
      relevance: top-k routing 动态分配计算。ThreadGate 可视为 MoD 在 turn boundary 上的特化
      abstract: Dynamically allocate FLOPs per layer via top-k routing. 1.5% loss improvement or 50% FLOP reduction.
    - title: Confident Adaptive Language Modeling (CALM)
      authors: Schuster et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.07061
      role: method-component
      relevance: 置信度 early exit。CALM 是 monotonic exit，ThreadGate 允许 selective layer gating
      abstract: Dynamically allocating compute per input based on confidence. Up to 3x speedup.
    - title: 'Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free'
      authors: Qiu et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2025 (Oral)
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06708
      role: method-component
      relevance: SDPA 输出加 sigmoid gate 消除 attention sink。可参考 head-specific sigmoid gate 设计
      abstract: Head-specific sigmoid gate after SDPA. Eliminates attention sink (83% to 4%).
    - title: 'SkipNet: Learning Dynamic Routing in Convolutional Networks'
      authors: Wang et al.
      venue: ECCV 2018
      year: 2018
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.09485
      role: method-component
      relevance: 残差网络逐层 gating 先驱。ThreadGate per-layer gating 的前身
      abstract: Gating network to selectively skip convolutional blocks. RL+SL hybrid training.
    - title: Adaptive Layer-skipping in Pre-trained LLMs (FlexiDepth)
      authors: Luo et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23798
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: plug-in router+adapter on frozen LLM 自适应 layer skipping。与 ThreadGate 高度类似，直接竞品
      abstract: Dynamically adjusts layers via plug-in router and adapter. Llama-3-8B skips 8/32 layers maintaining performance.
    - title: Learning to Skip the Middle Layers of Transformers
      authors: Lawson et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21103
      role: context
      relevance: middle-out layer skipping 负面结果参考
      abstract: Gating to skip middle blocks. Does not improve vs dense baselines at investigated scales.
  attention_manipulation:
    description: Methods that modify attention weights, positional encoding, or attention distributions to handle long-range
      dependencies
    papers:
    - title: 'Train Short, Test Long: Attention with Linear Biases Enables Input Length Extrapolation'
      authors: Press et al.
      venue: ICLR 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.12409
      role: foundation
      relevance: ALiBi 在注意力分数上施加距离线性惩罚实现长度外推，是注意力操纵路线的代表方法，与 ThreadGate 残差门控路线形成设计空间对比
      abstract: Replaces positional embeddings with linear bias on attention logits penalizing distance. 1.3B model trained
        on 1024 generalizes to 2048 without fine-tuning.
    - title: Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Positional Interpolation
      authors: Chen et al.
      venue: arXiv 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.15595
      role: foundation
      relevance: 位置插值通过压缩 RoPE 索引扩展上下文至 32k，属于注意力机制内部解决长序列的路线，与 ThreadGate 在残差层解决多轮衰减形成对比
      abstract: Linearly down-scales RoPE position indices to extend context to 32768 tokens in 1000 fine-tuning steps.
    - title: 'YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models'
      authors: Peng et al.
      venue: ICLR 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071
      role: foundation
      relevance: YaRN 综合 NTK-aware 和分段插值改进 RoPE 外推，代表注意力位置编码修改应对长程衰减的成熟路线，与 ThreadGate 机制不同
      abstract: Combines NTK-aware interpolation with ramp function for different RoPE frequency components. Extends LLaMA-2
        to 128k context with 10x fewer tokens.
    - title: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
      authors: Xiao et al.
      venue: ICLR 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.17453
      role: context
      relevance: 发现 attention sink 现象（初始 token 聚集高权重），说明多轮对话中早期轮次 token 天然受偏置，ThreadGate 从残差路径角度控制历史轮信息保留
      abstract: LLMs assign disproportionate attention to first few tokens regardless of semantics. Retaining sink tokens
        enables stable streaming inference over 4M tokens.
    - title: 'LM-Infinite: Zero-Shot Extreme Length Generalization for Large Language Models'
      authors: Han et al.
      venue: ACL 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.16137
      role: context
      relevance: 用 Λ 形注意力掩码加距离截断实现超长上下文推理，揭示调整注意力掩码和调整残差门控是两条平行路线
      abstract: Applies Λ-shaped attention mask plus distance limit on position encodings. Generalizes to 200M tokens with
        2.7x speedup, no parameter updates.
    - title: 'Found in the Middle: Calibrating Positional Attention Bias Improves Long Context Utilization'
      authors: Ko et al.
      venue: arXiv 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.16008
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: 直接校准注意力位置偏置修复中段信息丢失，最接近 ThreadGate 问题定义的注意力方案，审稿人会以此质疑为何不直接修正注意力
      abstract: Identifies U-shaped positional attention bias causing lost-in-the-middle. Training-free calibration redistributes
        attention to middle positions, improving QA by 6-15pp.
  theoretical_foundations:
    description: Theoretical analysis of transformer residual streams, information flow, and attention dynamics
    papers:
    - title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits
      authors: Elhage et al.
      venue: Transformer Circuits Thread 2021
      year: 2021
      url: https://transformer-circuits.pub/2021/framework/index.html
      role: foundation
      relevance: 提出残差流作为 transformer 各组件通信核心通道，直接为 ThreadGate 在残差连接处插入门控提供机制解释框架
      abstract: Linear algebraic decomposition of transformer computations. Attention heads and MLPs as read/write operations
        on shared residual stream. Formalizes induction heads and QK/OV circuits.
    - title: Toy Models of Superposition
      authors: Elhage et al.
      venue: arXiv 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.10652
      role: foundation
      relevance: 揭示残差流子空间叠加存储稀疏特征的机制，为 ThreadGate 按轮次条件化选择性激活残差通道提供理论依据
      abstract: Neural networks store more features than dimensions via superposition when features are sparse. Links polysemanticity
        to geometry of uniform polytopes.
    - title: Eliciting Latent Predictions from Transformers with the Tuned Lens
      authors: Belrose et al.
      venue: arXiv 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.08112
      role: foundation
      relevance: 逐层解码残差流隐状态揭示信息在深度方向渐进精化，支撑 ThreadGate 不同层门控强度差异化设计的动机
      abstract: Per-layer affine probes decode intermediate residual stream states into vocabulary distributions. Shows predictions
        iteratively refined across depth up to 20B parameters.
    - title: Exploring the Residual Stream of Transformers
      authors: Yu et al.
      venue: arXiv 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.12141
      role: foundation
      relevance: 分析残差连接对 logit 空间的加法效应，揭示知识参数跨层分布规律，为 ThreadGate 定位门控插入层提供实证参考
      abstract: Residual connections act as direct additive operations on pre-softmax logits. Identifies factual knowledge
        storage distribution across layers and modules.
    - title: 'Attention with Markov: A Framework for Principled Analysis of Transformers via Markov Chains'
      authors: Makkuva et al.
      venue: ICLR 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04161
      role: foundation
      relevance: 用 Markov 链理论刻画注意力深度依赖性，解释为何单层 transformer 无法形成归纳头，支持 ThreadGate 在多层残差路径施加门控的必要性
      abstract: Theoretical framework via Markov chain properties. Two-layer transformers learn induction heads on first-order
        Markov data; single-layer models get trapped in unigram minima.
    - title: 'From Self-Attention to Markov Models: Unveiling the Dynamics of Generative Transformers'
      authors: Ildiz et al.
      venue: ICML 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13512
      role: foundation
      relevance: 建立自注意力与上下文条件 Markov 链的精确映射，为分析多轮对话 token 分布随轮次漂移（GAR decay）提供随机过程理论基础
      abstract: Mathematical equivalence between self-attention and context-conditioned Markov chains. Output distribution
        sampled from context-weighted transition matrix.
  evaluation_benchmarks:
    description: Multi-turn dialogue and instruction-following evaluation benchmarks for LLMs
    papers:
    - title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
      authors: Zheng et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685
      role: foundation
      relevance: MT-Bench 多轮对话评测框架，是 ThreadGate 验证多轮 GAR 衰减修复效果的核心 benchmark
      abstract: Introduces MT-Bench (80 multi-turn questions) and Chatbot Arena. GPT-4 achieves >80% agreement with human
        preferences as judge.
    - title: 'Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference'
      authors: Chiang et al.
      venue: ICML 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.04132
      role: foundation
      relevance: 基于 ELO 排名的人类偏好评估体系，衡量多轮对话模型综合能力的权威 leaderboard
      abstract: Chatbot Arena with 240K+ votes from 90K+ users across 50+ models. Bradley-Terry and ELO ranking validated
        against expert raters.
    - title: 'Length-Controlled AlpacaEval: A Simple Way to Debias Automatic Evaluators'
      authors: Dubois et al.
      venue: COLM 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.04475
      role: foundation
      relevance: 指令遵循自动评测标准，Length-Controlled 版本修正长度偏差，为 ThreadGate 单轮指令评测提供对比基线
      abstract: GLM-based length debiasing for AlpacaEval. Validated against 20K human annotations.
    - title: 'WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild'
      authors: Lin et al.
      venue: arXiv 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04770
      role: foundation
      relevance: 真实用户多样化指令集，评估 wild 场景指令遵循能力，与 ThreadGate 关注的真实多轮对话性能高度相关
      abstract: 1,024 challenging tasks from 1M+ conversation logs. WB-Reward/WB-Score achieve 0.98 Pearson correlation with
        Chatbot Arena ELO on hard tasks.
    - title: 'MT-Bench-101: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues'
      authors: Bai et al.
      venue: ACL 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14762
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: 多轮对话细粒度评测体系，直接测量跨轮次能力退化，与 ThreadGate 研究的 GAR 衰减高度吻合
      abstract: Three-tier ability taxonomy, 4,208 turns across 1,388 dialogues in 13 tasks. Neither alignment nor chat-specific
        designs consistently improve multi-turn abilities.
    - title: 'MultiChallenge: A Realistic Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark Challenging to Frontier LLMs'
      authors: Sirdeshmukh et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.17399
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: 前沿 LLM 多轮对话准确率不足 50%，直接测量 ThreadGate 旨在修复的跨轮指令保留和上下文一致性失败
      abstract: 'Four challenge categories: instruction retention, user inference memory, versioned editing, self-coherence.
        All frontier LLMs below 50%; Claude 3.5 Sonnet tops at 41.4%.'
  exposure_bias:
    description: Exposure bias, teacher forcing, scheduled sampling, and train-test distribution mismatch in sequence generation
    papers:
    - title: Scheduled Sampling for Sequence Prediction with Recurrent Neural Networks
      authors: Bengio, Vinyals, Jaitly, Shazeer
      venue: NeurIPS 2015
      year: 2015
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.03099
      role: foundation
      relevance: Scheduled sampling 首次提出用 curriculum learning 缓解 teacher forcing 与推理时 autoregressive decoding 的分布不匹配（exposure
        bias），直接支撑论文对 auxiliary attention loss 训练-推理 gap 的根因分析
      abstract: Proposes a curriculum learning strategy to gently change training from fully guided (true previous token)
        to less guided (model-generated token). The discrepancy between teacher-forced training and autoregressive inference
        causes error accumulation. Experiments on sequence prediction tasks show significant improvements. Used in the winning
        MSCOCO image captioning challenge 2015 entry.
    - title: Sequence Level Training with Recurrent Neural Networks
      authors: Ranzato, Chopra, Auli, Zaremba
      venue: ICLR 2016
      year: 2016
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.06732
      role: foundation
      relevance: MIXER 算法直接优化测试时指标（BLEU/ROUGE）而非 token-level MLE，解决 teacher forcing 导致的 train-test discrepancy；论文中 auxiliary
        loss 同样面临 token-level 训练目标与 sequence-level 推理行为的错位
      abstract: Addresses the discrepancy between token-level MLE training and sequence-level generation at test time. Proposes
        sequence level training that directly optimizes test metrics (BLEU, ROUGE). Outperforms strong baselines for greedy
        generation on three tasks and is competitive with beam search while being several times faster.
    - title: 'Professor Forcing: A New Algorithm for Training Recurrent Networks'
      authors: Lamb, Goyal, Zhang, Zhang, Courville, Bengio
      venue: NeurIPS 2016
      year: 2016
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1610.09038
      role: foundation
      relevance: 用对抗训练对齐 teacher forcing 训练与 free-running 采样的 hidden state 动态分布，直接证明 train-test dynamics mismatch 可导致长序列采样质量崩溃——与论文中
        gating 机制推理时失效的现象高度对应
      abstract: Introduces Professor Forcing, which uses adversarial domain adaptation to encourage the dynamics of the recurrent
        network to be the same when training and when sampling over multiple time steps. Acts as a regularizer improving test
        likelihood on Penn Treebank and sequential MNIST. Qualitatively improves samples especially for long generation horizons.
        Discusses trade-offs with Scheduled Sampling.
    - title: 'SEARNN: Training RNNs with Global-Local Losses'
      authors: Leblond, Alayrac, Osokin, Lacoste-Julien
      venue: ICLR 2018
      year: 2018
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.04499
      role: context
      relevance: 基于 learning-to-search 理论统一分析 MLE 训练的两大缺陷：exposure bias 和结构化损失信息浪费。论文中 auxiliary attention loss 同时受这两个缺陷影响——token-level
        loss 无法反映 sequence-level attention pattern
      abstract: Proposes SEARNN inspired by learning-to-search (L2S) approach to structured prediction. MLE training fails
        to exploit structured losses and introduces train-test discrepancies (exposure bias). SEARNN leverages test-alike
        search space exploration for global-local losses closer to test error. Demonstrates improvements on OCR, spelling
        correction, and machine translation with a subsampling strategy for large vocabularies.
    - title: Quantifying Exposure Bias for Neural Language Generation
      authors: He, Zhang, Zhou, Glass
      venue: arXiv 2019
      year: 2019
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.10617

## Core Research Papers

**Scheduled Sampling for Transformers (2019)**
Scheduled sampling is a technique for avoiding exposure bias in sequence-to-sequence generation, consisting of feeding the model a mix of teacher forced embeddings and model predictions from the previous step in training time.       abstract: Defines Block Influence (BI) metric to gauge layer significance. Discovers many LLM layers exhibit high similarity.
    - title: The Curse of Depth in Large Language Models
      authors: Sun et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05795
      role: foundation
      relevance: Pre-LN 导致深层梯度趋近恒等映射。解释 ThreadGate 中 late layers gate 接近 1.0
      abstract: Pre-Layer Normalization causes output variance to grow exponentially with depth.
    - title: 'Reassessing Layer Pruning in LLMs: New Insights and Methods'
      authors: Anonymous
      venue: arXiv 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15558
      role: context
      relevance: 删除最后 25% 层 + 微调即可获得强性能，证实深层冗余
      abstract: Simply pruning the final 25% of layers followed by fine-tuning yields strong performance.
    - title: Reducing Transformer Depth on Demand with Structured Dropout (LayerDrop)
      authors: Fan et al.
      venue: ICLR 2020
      year: 2020
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.11556
      role: method-component
      relevance: ThreadGate 的 gating 可视为 LayerDrop 的 soft 版本
      abstract: Structured dropout on entire transformer layers during training.
  multi_turn_attention:
    description: Attention degradation and instruction following failure in multi-turn or long-context scenarios
    papers:
    - title: 'When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction'
      authors: Dongre, Hsieh, Lai, Yoon, Bui, Hakkani-Tur
      venue: arXiv 2026
      year: 2026
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12922
      role: foundation
      relevance: 定义 GAR，诊断多轮 attention 通道关闭。纯诊断论文，未提出干预方案。ThreadGate 是首个基于其诊断的干预方法
      abstract: 'Channel-transition account: goal tokens become less accessible through attention while goal info persists
        in residual representations. Introduces GAR metric.'
      notes:
        gar_definition: GAR(τ) = (1/L·H·|ℛτ|) Σℓ Σh Σi∈ℛτ Σj∈𝒢 A_{i,j}. ALL layers, ALL heads averaged. Goal tokens = system
          prompt task-specifying tokens only
        models_tested: Mistral-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5 (3B/7B/14B/32B), Mixtral-8x7B + 6 additional
        gar_decline: 27-48% over 50 turns, monotonic (Mann-Kendall p<1e-7)
        residual_probes: 'LDA on PCA-reduced residuals (50 PCs). Peak AUC: LLaMA L2=0.99, Qwen L11=0.98, Mixtral L21=0.99,
          Mistral L27=0.87'
        qwen_layer_profile: Goal encoding rises steeply from L5. Our v3b L4 outlier may be the layer just before goal encoding
          begins
        intervention_tested: Periodic goal re-injection FAILED (Appendix H)
        no_solution: true
        sliding_window: Attention mask W=4096, Qwen crossover at turn 20. Linear W-vs-crossover (R2~1)
        framing_impact: GAR not our original metric. No intervention proposed -> ThreadGate is first solution. Residual persistence
          directly supports our theory
    - title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation
      authors: Levy et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06120
      role: foundation
      relevance: 量化多轮对话性能衰减：平均下降 39%，不可靠性增加 112%
      abstract: All top LLMs exhibit significantly lower performance in multi-turn vs single-turn, averaging 39% drop.
    - title: Intent Mismatch Causes LLMs to Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation
      authors: Liu et al.
      venue: arXiv 2026
      year: 2026
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07338
      role: context
      relevance: 多轮失败根因是 intent alignment gap，scaling 无法解决。支撑 ThreadGate 架构级方案动机
      abstract: Lost in Conversation stems from intent alignment gap, not capability deficits. Scaling cannot resolve.
    - title: 'Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts'
      authors: Liu et al.
      venue: TACL 2024
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172
      role: foundation
      relevance: U 型 attention 分布（首尾强、中间弱）。多轮场景是此现象在 turn boundary 上的扩展
      abstract: Performance highest at beginning/end of context, degrading for middle positions.
    - title: 'Style Amnesia: Investigating Speaking Style Degradation and Mitigation in Multi-Turn Spoken Language Models'
      authors: Anonymous
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23578
      role: context
      relevance: 多轮对话中 style instruction 遵循衰减，system message 比 user message 更严重
      abstract: Style instruction in system messages degrades more than in user messages across turns.
  residual_gating:
    description: Gating mechanisms for transformer residual connections and adaptive depth
    papers:
    - title: 'Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models'
      authors: Raposo et al.
      venue: arXiv 2024 (Google DeepMind)
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02258
      role: method-component
      relevance: top-k routing 动态分配计算。ThreadGate 可视为 MoD 在 turn boundary 上的特化
      abstract: Dynamically allocate FLOPs per layer via top-k routing. 1.5% loss improvement or 50% FLOP reduction.
    - title: Confident Adaptive Language Modeling (CALM)
      authors: Schuster et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.07061
      role: method-component
      relevance: 置信度 early exit。CALM 是 monotonic exit，ThreadGate 允许 selective layer gating
      abstract: Dynamically allocating compute per input based on confidence. Up to 3x speedup.
    - title: 'Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free'
      authors: Qiu et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2025 (Oral)
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.06708
      role: method-component
      relevance: SDPA 输出加 sigmoid gate 消除 attention sink。可参考 head-specific sigmoid gate 设计
      abstract: Head-specific sigmoid gate after SDPA. Eliminates attention sink (83% to 4%).
    - title: 'SkipNet: Learning Dynamic Routing in Convolutional Networks'
      authors: Wang et al.
      venue: ECCV 2018
      year: 2018
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.09485
      role: method-component
      relevance: 残差网络逐层 gating 先驱。ThreadGate per-layer gating 的前身
      abstract: Gating network to selectively skip convolutional blocks. RL+SL hybrid training.
    - title: Adaptive Layer-skipping in Pre-trained LLMs (FlexiDepth)
      authors: Luo et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23798
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: plug-in router+adapter on frozen LLM 自适应 layer skipping。与 ThreadGate 高度类似，直接竞品
      abstract: Dynamically adjusts layers via plug-in router and adapter. Llama-3-8B skips 8/32 layers maintaining performance.
    - title: Learning to Skip the Middle Layers of Transformers
      authors: Lawson et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21103
      role: context
      relevance: middle-out layer skipping 负面结果参考
      abstract: Gating to skip middle blocks. Does not improve vs dense baselines at investigated scales.
  attention_manipulation:
    description: Methods that modify attention weights, positional encoding, or attention distributions to handle long-range
      dependencies
    papers:
    - title: 'Train Short, Test Long: Attention with Linear Biases Enables Input Length Extrapolation'
      authors: Press et al.
      venue: ICLR 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.12409
      role: foundation
      relevance: ALiBi 在注意力分数上施加距离线性惩罚实现长度外推，是注意力操纵路线的代表方法，与 ThreadGate 残差门控路线形成设计空间对比
      abstract: Replaces positional embeddings with linear bias on attention logits penalizing distance. 1.3B model trained
        on 1024 generalizes to 2048 without fine-tuning.
    - title: Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Positional Interpolation
      authors: Chen et al.
      venue: arXiv 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.15595
      role: foundation
      relevance: 位置插值通过压缩 RoPE 索引扩展上下文至 32k，属于注意力机制内部解决长序列的路线，与 ThreadGate 在残差层解决多轮衰减形成对比
      abstract: Linearly down-scales RoPE position indices to extend context to 32768 tokens in 1000 fine-tuning steps.
    - title: 'YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models'
      authors: Peng et al.
      venue: ICLR 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071
      role: foundation
      relevance: YaRN 综合 NTK-aware 和分段插值改进 RoPE 外推，代表注意力位置编码修改应对长程衰减的成熟路线，与 ThreadGate 机制不同
      abstract: Combines NTK-aware interpolation with ramp function for different RoPE frequency components. Extends LLaMA-2
        to 128k context with 10x fewer tokens.
    - title: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
      authors: Xiao et al.
      venue: ICLR 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.17453
      role: context
      relevance: 发现 attention sink 现象（初始 token 聚集高权重），说明多轮对话中早期轮次 token 天然受偏置，ThreadGate 从残差路径角度控制历史轮信息保留
      abstract: LLMs assign disproportionate attention to first few tokens regardless of semantics. Retaining sink tokens
        enables stable streaming inference over 4M tokens.
    - title: 'LM-Infinite: Zero-Shot Extreme Length Generalization for Large Language Models'
      authors: Han et al.
      venue: ACL 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.16137
      role: context
      relevance: 用 Λ 形注意力掩码加距离截断实现超长上下文推理，揭示调整注意力掩码和调整残差门控是两条平行路线
      abstract: Applies Λ-shaped attention mask plus distance limit on position encodings. Generalizes to 200M tokens with
        2.7x speedup, no parameter updates.
    - title: 'Found in the Middle: Calibrating Positional Attention Bias Improves Long Context Utilization'
      authors: Ko et al.
      venue: arXiv 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.16008
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: 直接校准注意力位置偏置修复中段信息丢失，最接近 ThreadGate 问题定义的注意力方案，审稿人会以此质疑为何不直接修正注意力
      abstract: Identifies U-shaped positional attention bias causing lost-in-the-middle. Training-free calibration redistributes
        attention to middle positions, improving QA by 6-15pp.
  theoretical_foundations:
    description: Theoretical analysis of transformer residual streams, information flow, and attention dynamics
    papers:
    - title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits
      authors: Elhage et al.
      venue: Transformer Circuits Thread 2021
      year: 2021
      url: https://transformer-circuits.pub/2021/framework/index.html
      role: foundation
      relevance: 提出残差流作为 transformer 各组件通信核心通道，直接为 ThreadGate 在残差连接处插入门控提供机制解释框架
      abstract: Linear algebraic decomposition of transformer computations. Attention heads and MLPs as read/write operations
        on shared residual stream. Formalizes induction heads and QK/OV circuits.
    - title: Toy Models of Superposition
      authors: Elhage et al.
      venue: arXiv 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.10652
      role: foundation
      relevance: 揭示残差流子空间叠加存储稀疏特征的机制，为 ThreadGate 按轮次条件化选择性激活残差通道提供理论依据
      abstract: Neural networks store more features than dimensions via superposition when features are sparse. Links polysemanticity
        to geometry of uniform polytopes.
    - title: Eliciting Latent Predictions from Transformers with the Tuned Lens
      authors: Belrose et al.
      venue: arXiv 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.08112
      role: foundation
      relevance: 逐层解码残差流隐状态揭示信息在深度方向渐进精化，支撑 ThreadGate 不同层门控强度差异化设计的动机
      abstract: Per-layer affine probes decode intermediate residual stream states into vocabulary distributions. Shows predictions
        iteratively refined across depth up to 20B parameters.
    - title: Exploring the Residual Stream of Transformers
      authors: Yu et al.
      venue: arXiv 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.12141
      role: foundation
      relevance: 分析残差连接对 logit 空间的加法效应，揭示知识参数跨层分布规律，为 ThreadGate 定位门控插入层提供实证参考
      abstract: Residual connections act as direct additive operations on pre-softmax logits. Identifies factual knowledge
        storage distribution across layers and modules.
    - title: 'Attention with Markov: A Framework for Principled Analysis of Transformers via Markov Chains'
      authors: Makkuva et al.
      venue: ICLR 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04161
      role: foundation
      relevance: 用 Markov 链理论刻画注意力深度依赖性，解释为何单层 transformer 无法形成归纳头，支持 ThreadGate 在多层残差路径施加门控的必要性
      abstract: Theoretical framework via Markov chain properties. Two-layer transformers learn induction heads on first-order
        Markov data; single-layer models get trapped in unigram minima.
    - title: 'From Self-Attention to Markov Models: Unveiling the Dynamics of Generative Transformers'
      authors: Ildiz et al.
      venue: ICML 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13512
      role: foundation
      relevance: 建立自注意力与上下文条件 Markov 链的精确映射，为分析多轮对话 token 分布随轮次漂移（GAR decay）提供随机过程理论基础
      abstract: Mathematical equivalence between self-attention and context-conditioned Markov chains. Output distribution
        sampled from context-weighted transition matrix.
  evaluation_benchmarks:
    description: Multi-turn dialogue and instruction-following evaluation benchmarks for LLMs
    papers:
    - title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
      authors: Zheng et al.
      venue: NeurIPS 2023
      year: 2023
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685
      role: foundation
      relevance: MT-Bench 多轮对话评测框架，是 ThreadGate 验证多轮 GAR 衰减修复效果的核心 benchmark
      abstract: Introduces MT-Bench (80 multi-turn questions) and Chatbot Arena. GPT-4 achieves >80% agreement with human
        preferences as judge.
    - title: 'Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference'
      authors: Chiang et al.
      venue: ICML 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.04132
      role: foundation
      relevance: 基于 ELO 排名的人类偏好评估体系，衡量多轮对话模型综合能力的权威 leaderboard
      abstract: Chatbot Arena with 240K+ votes from 90K+ users across 50+ models. Bradley-Terry and ELO ranking validated
        against expert raters.
    - title: 'Length-Controlled AlpacaEval: A Simple Way to Debias Automatic Evaluators'
      authors: Dubois et al.
      venue: COLM 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.04475
      role: foundation
      relevance: 指令遵循自动评测标准，Length-Controlled 版本修正长度偏差，为 ThreadGate 单轮指令评测提供对比基线
      abstract: GLM-based length debiasing for AlpacaEval. Validated against 20K human annotations.
    - title: 'WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild'
      authors: Lin et al.
      venue: arXiv 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.04770
      role: foundation
      relevance: 真实用户多样化指令集，评估 wild 场景指令遵循能力，与 ThreadGate 关注的真实多轮对话性能高度相关
      abstract: 1,024 challenging tasks from 1M+ conversation logs. WB-Reward/WB-Score achieve 0.98 Pearson correlation with
        Chatbot Arena ELO on hard tasks.
    - title: 'MT-Bench-101: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues'
      authors: Bai et al.
      venue: ACL 2024
      year: 2024
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14762
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: 多轮对话细粒度评测体系，直接测量跨轮次能力退化，与 ThreadGate 研究的 GAR 衰减高度吻合
      abstract: Three-tier ability taxonomy, 4,208 turns across 1,388 dialogues in 13 tasks. Neither alignment nor chat-specific
        designs consistently improve multi-turn abilities.
    - title: 'MultiChallenge: A Realistic Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark Challenging to Frontier LLMs'
      authors: Sirdeshmukh et al.
      venue: arXiv 2025
      year: 2025
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.17399
      role: direct-competitor
      relevance: 前沿 LLM 多轮对话准确率不足 50%，直接测量 ThreadGate 旨在修复的跨轮指令保留和上下文一致性失败
      abstract: 'Four challenge categories: instruction retention, user inference memory, versioned editing, self-coherence.
        All frontier LLMs below 50%; Claude 3.5 Sonnet tops at 41.4%.'
  exposure_bias:
    description: Exposure bias, teacher forcing, scheduled sampling, and train-test distribution mismatch in sequence generation
    papers:
    - title: Scheduled Sampling for Sequence Prediction with Recurrent Neural Networks
      authors: Bengio, Vinyals, Jaitly, Shazeer
      venue: NeurIPS 2015
      year: 2015
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.03099
      role: foundation
      relevance: Scheduled sampling 首次提出用 curriculum learning 缓解 teacher forcing 与推理时 autoregressive decoding 的分布不匹配（exposure
        bias），直接支撑论文对 auxiliary attention loss 训练-推理 gap 的根因分析
      abstract: Proposes a curriculum learning strategy to gently change training from fully guided (true previous token)
        to less guided (model-generated token). The discrepancy between teacher-forced training and autoregressive inference
        causes error accumulation. Experiments on sequence prediction tasks show significant improvements. Used in the winning
        MSCOCO image captioning challenge 2015 entry.
    - title: Sequence Level Training with Recurrent Neural Networks
      authors: Ranzato, Chopra, Auli, Zaremba
      venue: ICLR 2016
      year: 2016
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.06732
      role: foundation
      relevance: MIXER 算法直接优化测试时指标（BLEU/ROUGE）而非 token-level MLE，解决 teacher forcing 导致的 train-test discrepancy；论文中 auxiliary
        loss 同样面临 token-level 训练目标与 sequence-level 推理行为的错位
      abstract: Addresses the discrepancy between token-level MLE training and sequence-level generation at test time. Proposes
        sequence level training that directly optimizes test metrics (BLEU, ROUGE). Outperforms strong baselines for greedy
        generation on three tasks and is competitive with beam search while being several times faster.
    - title: 'Professor Forcing: A New Algorithm for Training Recurrent Networks'
      authors: Lamb, Goyal, Zhang, Zhang, Courville, Bengio
      venue: NeurIPS 2016
      year: 2016
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1610.09038
      role: foundation
      relevance: 用对抗训练对齐 teacher forcing 训练与 free-running 采样的 hidden state 动态分布，直接证明 train-test dynamics mismatch 可导致长序列采样质量崩溃——与论文中
        gating 机制推理时失效的现象高度对应
      abstract: Introduces Professor Forcing, which uses adversarial domain adaptation to encourage the dynamics of the recurrent
        network to be the same when training and when sampling over multiple time steps. Acts as a regularizer improving test
        likelihood on Penn Treebank and sequential MNIST. Qualitatively improves samples especially for long generation horizons.
        Discusses trade-offs with Scheduled Sampling.
    - title: 'SEARNN: Training RNNs with Global-Local Losses'
      authors: Leblond, Alayrac, Osokin, Lacoste-Julien
      venue: ICLR 2018
      year: 2018
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.04499
      role: context
      relevance: 基于 learning-to-search 理论统一分析 MLE 训练的两大缺陷：exposure bias 和结构化损失信息浪费。论文中 auxiliary attention loss 同时受这两个缺陷影响——token-level
        loss 无法反映 sequence-level attention pattern
      abstract: Proposes SEARNN inspired by learning-to-search (L2S) approach to structured prediction. MLE training fails
        to exploit structured losses and introduces train-test discrepancies (exposure bias). SEARNN leverages test-alike
        search space exploration for global-local losses closer to test error. Demonstrates improvements on OCR, spelling
        correction, and machine translation with a subsampling strategy for large vocabularies.
    - title: Quantifying Exposure Bias for Neural Language Generation
      authors: He, Zhang, Zhou, Glass
      venue: arXiv 2019
      year: 2019
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.10617
      role: foundation
      relevance: 首次定量度量 exposure bias 影响并发现 LM 的 self-recovery 能力——即模型能从错误前缀部分恢复。这为论文分析 gating 机制在推理时的行为提供关键对照：如果 exposure
        bias 可自恢复，auxiliary loss 崩溃可能源于更根本的分布偏移
      abstract: 'Proposes sequence-level (EB-bleu) and word-level (EB-C) metrics to quantify exposure bias impact on quality,
        diversity, and consistency. Key finding: contrary to popular belief, distortion from prefix discrepancy is limited
        and does not appear incremental. Reveals an interesting self-recovery ability of language models that counters harmful
        effects of exposure bias.'
  gradient_conflict_mtl:
    description: Multi-task gradient conflict resolution, gradient surgery, and loss balancing methods
    papers:
    - title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
      authors: Yu, Kumar, Gupta, Levine, Hausman, Finn
      venue: NeurIPS 2020
      year: 2020
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.06782
      role: must-cite
      relevance: 提出 PCGrad，通过投影消除任务间梯度冲突。论文直接使用 PCGrad 做因果排除实验，证明梯度冲突不是 auxiliary attention loss 泛化失败的根因
      abstract: 'Proposes PCGrad: when gradients between tasks conflict, project one onto the normal plane of the other to
        remove the conflicting component. Demonstrates consistent improvements on multi-task supervised learning and multi-task
        reinforcement learning benchmarks.'
    - title: 'GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing in Deep Multitask Networks'
      authors: Chen, Badrinarayanan, Lee, Rabinovich
      venue: ICML 2018
      year: 2018
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.02257
      role: must-cite
      relevance: 首个自动平衡多任务梯度幅度的方法，通过动态调整各任务梯度范数使训练速率一致。为论文中 auxiliary loss 权重调优的 baseline 和梯度冲突缓解方法的早期代表
      abstract: Automatically balances training in deep multitask models by dynamically tuning gradient magnitudes. Introduces
        a loss-rate-based gradient normalization algorithm that adjusts gradients to ensure tasks train at similar rates.
        Shows improvements on NYUv2 and other benchmarks.
    - title: Conflict-Averse Gradient Descent for Multi-task Learning
      authors: Liu, Liu, Jin, Stone, Liu
      venue: NeurIPS 2021
      year: 2021
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.14048
      role: context
      relevance: 提出 CAGrad，在共享参数空间上寻找与所有任务梯度最小冲突的更新方向。作为 PCGrad 之后梯度冲突解决方法的演进，支撑论文对该路线充分覆盖后仍无法解决 attention degradation 的论证
      abstract: Proposes Conflict-Averse Gradient descent (CAGrad) that minimizes the average loss while explicitly constraining
        the worst-case task performance. Finds an update direction within a ball around the average gradient that maximizes
        the minimum improvement across tasks. Achieves state-of-the-art on multi-task learning benchmarks.
    - title: Multi-Task Learning as a Bargaining Game
      authors: Navon, Shamsian, Achituve, Maron, Kawaguchi, Chechik, Fetaya
      venue: ICML 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.01017
      role: context

      abstract: 'Channel-transition account: goal tokens become less accessible through attention while goal info persists

      notes:
        gar_definition: GAR(τ) = (1/L·H·|ℛτ|) Σℓ Σh Σi∈ℛτ Σj∈𝒢 A_{i,j}. ALL layers, ALL heads averaged. Goal tokens = system

        models_tested: Mistral-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5 (3B/7B/14B/32B), Mixtral-8x7B + 6 additional

        qwen_layer_profile: Goal encoding rises steeply from L5. Our v3b L4 outlier may be the layer just before goal encoding

  exposure_bias:
    description: Exposure bias, teacher forcing, scheduled sampling, and train-test distribution mismatch in sequence generation
    papers:
    - title: Scheduled Sampling for Sequence Prediction with Recurrent Neural Networks
      authors: Bengio, Vinyals, Jaitly, Shazeer
      venue: NeurIPS 2015
      year: 2015
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.03099
      role: foundation
      relevance: Scheduled sampling 首次提出用 curriculum learning 缓解 teacher forcing 与推理时 autoregressive decoding 的分布不匹配（exposure
        bias），直接支撑论文对 auxiliary attention loss 训练-推理 gap 的根因分析
      abstract: Proposes a curriculum learning strategy to gently change training from fully guided (true previous token)
        to less guided (model-generated token). The discrepancy between teacher-forced training and autoregressive inference
        causes error accumulation. Experiments on sequence prediction tasks show significant improvements. Used in the winning
        MSCOCO image captioning challenge 2015 entry.
    - title: Sequence Level Training with Recurrent Neural Networks
      authors: Ranzato, Chopra, Auli, Zaremba
      venue: ICLR 2016
      year: 2016
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.06732
      role: foundation
      relevance: MIXER 算法直接优化测试时指标（BLEU/ROUGE）而非 token-level MLE，解决 teacher forcing 导致的 train-test discrepancy；论文中 auxiliary
        loss 同样面临 token-level 训练目标与 sequence-level 推理行为的错位
      abstract: Addresses the discrepancy between token-level MLE training and sequence-level generation at test time. Proposes
        sequence level training that directly optimizes test metrics (BLEU, ROUGE). Outperforms strong baselines for greedy
        generation on three tasks and is competitive with beam search while being several times faster.
    - title: 'Professor Forcing: A New Algorithm for Training Recurrent Networks'
      authors: Lamb, Goyal, Zhang, Zhang, Courville, Bengio
      venue: NeurIPS 2016
      year: 2016
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1610.09038
      role: foundation
      relevance: 用对抗训练对齐 teacher forcing 训练与 free-running 采样的 hidden state 动态分布，直接证明 train-test dynamics mismatch 可导致长序列采样质量崩溃——与论文中
        gating 机制推理时失效的现象高度对应
      abstract: Introduces Professor Forcing, which uses adversarial domain adaptation to encourage the dynamics of the recurrent
        network to be the same when training and when sampling over multiple time steps. Acts as a regularizer improving test
        likelihood on Penn Treebank and sequential MNIST. Qualitatively improves samples especially for long generation horizons.
        Discusses trade-offs with Scheduled Sampling.
    - title: 'SEARNN: Training RNNs with Global-Local Losses'
      authors: Leblond, Alayrac, Osokin, Lacoste-Julien
      venue: ICLR 2018
      year: 2018
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.04499
      role: context
      relevance: 基于 learning-to-search 理论统一分析 MLE 训练的两大缺陷：exposure bias 和结构化损失信息浪费。论文中 auxiliary attention loss 同时受这两个缺陷影响——token-level
        loss 无法反映 sequence-level attention pattern
      abstract: Proposes SEARNN inspired by learning-to-search (L2S) approach to structured prediction. MLE training fails
        to exploit structured losses and introduces train-test discrepancies (exposure bias). SEARNN leverages test-alike
        search space exploration for global-local losses closer to test error. Demonstrates improvements on OCR, spelling
        correction, and machine translation with a subsampling strategy for large vocabularies.
    - title: Quantifying Exposure Bias for Neural Language Generation
      authors: He, Zhang, Zhou, Glass
      venue: arXiv 2019
      year: 2019
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.10617
      role: foundation
      relevance: 首次定量度量 exposure bias 影响并发现 LM 的 self-recovery 能力——即模型能从错误前缀部分恢复。这为论文分析 gating 机制在推理时的行为提供关键对照：如果 exposure
        bias 可自恢复，auxiliary loss 崩溃可能源于更根本的分布偏移
      abstract: 'Proposes sequence-level (EB-bleu) and word-level (EB-C) metrics to quantify exposure bias impact on quality,
        diversity, and consistency. Key finding: contrary to popular belief, distortion from prefix discrepancy is limited
        and does not appear incremental. Reveals an interesting self-recovery ability of language models that counters harmful
        effects of exposure bias.'
    - title: Sequence-to-Sequence Learning as Beam-Search Optimization
      authors: Wiseman, Rush
      venue: EMNLP 2016
      year: 2016
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.02960
      role: foundation
      relevance: 提出 beam-aware 训练将训练目标与测试时解码统一，量化 teacher forcing 的 train-test discrepancy 对序列生成质量的影响。paper_framing SP1 明确引用为
        exposure bias 在 sequence generation 中的量化先例
      abstract: Proposes a model and beam-search training scheme that extends seq2seq to learn global sequence scores, avoiding
        local training biases and unifying training loss with test-time usage. Outperforms attention-based seq2seq on word ordering,
        parsing, and machine translation.
    - title: 'Bridging the Gap between Training and Inference for Neural Machine Translation'
      authors: Zhang, Feng, Meng, You, Liu
      venue: ACL 2019
      year: 2019
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.02448
      role: method-component
      relevance: 在训练时混合 ground truth 和 model-generated tokens 作为上下文，用 sentence-level optimum 选择预测序列。直接对应论文 W8 中讨论的
        exposure bias mitigation 实验方向——若应用于 auxiliary attention loss 可能缩小 30x gap
      abstract: Addresses exposure bias in NMT by sampling context words from both ground truth and model predictions during
        training, selecting predicted sequences with sentence-level optimum. Achieves significant improvements on Chinese-English
        and WMT14 English-German translation.
    - title: Why Exposure Bias Matters: An Imitation Learning Perspective of Error Accumulation in Language Generation
      authors: Arora, El Asri, Bahuleyan, Cheung
      venue: ACL Findings 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.01171
      role: theoretical-foundation
      relevance: 用 imitation learning 框架证明 exposure bias 导致 compounding error accumulation，且 perplexity 无法捕捉此累积效应。直接支撑论文核心论证：auxiliary
        attention loss 的 PPL 正常但 GAR 崩溃，因为 perplexity 掩盖了分布偏移对 attention pattern 的破坏
      abstract: Shows that exposure bias leads to accumulation of errors in autoregressive generation. Analyzes why perplexity
        fails to capture this accumulation. Empirically demonstrates that compounding errors from train-test mismatch degrade
        generation quality even when perplexity appears normal.
    - title: Scheduled Sampling for Transformers
      authors: Mihaylova, Martins
      venue: ACL SRW 2019
      year: 2019
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.07651
      role: method-component
      relevance: 将 Bengio 2015 的 scheduled sampling 扩展到 transformer 架构，通过 two-pass decoding 策略解决 transformer 非自回归 decoder 的适配问题。直接相关于论文
        Discussion 中讨论的 scheduled sampling 应用于 auxiliary attention loss 的未来方向
      abstract: Extends scheduled sampling to Transformer architecture via two-pass decoding strategy. Proposes structural changes
        to allow mixing of teacher-forced embeddings and model predictions during transformer training for exposure bias mitigation.
  gradient_conflict_mtl:
    description: Multi-task gradient conflict resolution, gradient surgery, and loss balancing methods
    papers:
    - title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
      authors: Yu, Kumar, Gupta, Levine, Hausman, Finn
      venue: NeurIPS 2020
      year: 2020
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.06782
      role: must-cite
      relevance: 提出 PCGrad，通过投影消除任务间梯度冲突。论文直接使用 PCGrad 做因果排除实验，证明梯度冲突不是 auxiliary attention loss 泛化失败的根因
      abstract: 'Proposes PCGrad: when gradients between tasks conflict, project one onto the normal plane of the other to
        remove the conflicting component. Demonstrates consistent improvements on multi-task supervised learning and multi-task
        reinforcement learning benchmarks.'
    - title: 'GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing in Deep Multitask Networks'
      authors: Chen, Badrinarayanan, Lee, Rabinovich
      venue: ICML 2018
      year: 2018
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.02257
      role: must-cite
      relevance: 首个自动平衡多任务梯度幅度的方法，通过动态调整各任务梯度范数使训练速率一致。为论文中 auxiliary loss 权重调优的 baseline 和梯度冲突缓解方法的早期代表
      abstract: Automatically balances training in deep multitask models by dynamically tuning gradient magnitudes. Introduces
        a loss-rate-based gradient normalization algorithm that adjusts gradients to ensure tasks train at similar rates.
        Shows improvements on NYUv2 and other benchmarks.
    - title: Conflict-Averse Gradient Descent for Multi-task Learning
      authors: Liu, Liu, Jin, Stone, Liu
      venue: NeurIPS 2021
      year: 2021
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.14048
      role: context
      relevance: 提出 CAGrad，在共享参数空间上寻找与所有任务梯度最小冲突的更新方向。作为 PCGrad 之后梯度冲突解决方法的演进，支撑论文对该路线充分覆盖后仍无法解决 attention degradation 的论证
      abstract: Proposes Conflict-Averse Gradient descent (CAGrad) that minimizes the average loss while explicitly constraining
        the worst-case task performance. Finds an update direction within a ball around the average gradient that maximizes
        the minimum improvement across tasks. Achieves state-of-the-art on multi-task learning benchmarks.
    - title: Multi-Task Learning as a Bargaining Game
      authors: Navon, Shamsian, Achituve, Maron, Kawaguchi, Chechik, Fetaya
      venue: ICML 2022
      year: 2022
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.01017
      role: context
      relevance: 将多任务梯度聚合建模为 Nash 博弈问题（Nash-MTL），理论证明 Nash 均衡解优于启发式梯度操作。作为梯度冲突解决的最新理论上界，强化论文"即使最优梯度调和也无法修复 attention degradation"的论证
      abstract: Frames multi-task gradient aggregation as a bargaining game and proposes Nash-MTL that finds the Nash bargaining
        solution. Provides theoretical guarantees showing the Nash solution is Pareto optimal. Achieves state-of-the-art on
        multiple MTL benchmarks including NYUv2, QM9, and CELEBA.
  residual_scaling:
    description: Residual connection scaling, initialization, and zero-init methods for deep transformers
    papers:
    - title: 'ReZero is All You Need: Fast Convergence at Large Depth'
      authors: Bachlechner, Majumder, Mao, Cottrell, McAuley
      venue: UAI 2021
      year: 2021
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.04887
      role: must-cite
      relevance: ThreadGate 的 per-layer sigmoid gate 直接源自 ReZero 的零初始化残差缩放思想：x_{l+1} = x_l + alpha_l * f_l(x_l)，alpha 初始化为
        0。ThreadGate 将标量 alpha 替换为 turn-conditioned sigmoid gate
      abstract: Initializes each residual connection with a learnable zero-initialized parameter, enabling training of extremely
        deep transformers (up to 10,000 layers) without warmup or normalization. Achieves significantly faster convergence
        by allowing the network to start as identity and gradually incorporate layer contributions.
    - title: 'Fixup Initialization: Residual Learning Without Normalization'
      authors: Zhang, Dauphin, Ma
      venue: ICLR 2019
      year: 2019
      url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.09321
      role: foundation
      relevance: 理论推导残差分支的初始化缩放如何控制梯度爆炸，为 ReZero 和 ThreadGate 的残差缩放设计提供数学基础。证明适当的残差缩放可完全替代 normalization layers
      abstract: Proposes a properly scaled initialization for residual networks that enables training very deep models without
        normalization layers. Theoretically shows that residual branch scaling by 1/sqrt(L) prevents gradient explosion. Matches
        BatchNorm performance on ImageNet and CIFAR with ResNets up to 110 layers.
